title: Head of Human Resources
description:
Head of Human Resources
 
**Company:** 
 10x Global
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Gurgaon
 



**Reporting to:** 
 CEO
 



**Experience:** 
 8–12 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 


 About 10x Global
 
 10x Global is a global business advisory platform helping companies
 **enter, operate and scale across markets** 
 . With teams and operations across India, UAE, Singapore and the US, we work with ambitious founders, startups, multinational businesses and investors on market entry, tax, finance, compliance, transactions and strategic growth.
 



 As we scale, we are looking for a
 **Head of Human Resources** 
 to build the people function into a genuine strategic advantage for the organisation.
 


 The Role
 
 This is not a traditional HR administration role.
 



 You will own the entire employee lifecycle — from
 **hiring and onboarding to performance, culture, development, compensation and exits** 
 — while building the systems and processes required for a high\-performance, entrepreneurial organisation.
 



 The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable:
 


* Building HR strategy
* Hiring exceptional people
* Fixing broken processes
* Managing employee issues
* Driving performance
* Building culture
* Working directly with partners and the CEO
* Using data to identify and solve people problems



 You will be the
 **custodian of the 10x Global culture and employee experience** 
 .
 


 Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 * Own the end\-to\-end recruitment function across India and international offices.
* Build hiring plans aligned with business growth and revenue targets.
* Develop strong talent pipelines for critical roles across consulting, tax, finance, legal, technology, sales, marketing and operations.
* Improve quality and speed of hiring while maintaining high hiring standards.
* Build structured interview frameworks and assessment processes.
* Establish relationships with executive search firms, recruitment partners, campuses and talent networks.
* Develop a strong employer brand for 10x Global.
* Ensure every new hire has clear role expectations, KPIs and a defined onboarding plan.



**Success metric:** 
 Right people, hired quickly, into the right roles.
 


 2\. Performance Management
 
 Build a
 **high\-performance culture** 
 where people know what is expected of them.
 


* Design and implement a company\-wide performance management framework.
* Establish KRAs/KPIs for every function and role.
* Run quarterly performance reviews and annual appraisal cycles.
* Build mechanisms for continuous feedback rather than annual\-only reviews.
* Work with managers to identify underperformance early.
* Create structured Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Identify high performers and build accelerated growth plans for them.
* Ensure compensation, promotions and career progression are linked to performance.



**Core principle:** 
 No ambiguity around performance.
 


 3\. Employee Engagement \& Culture
 
 Take ownership of making 10x Global a place where ambitious people
 **want to work and grow** 
 .
 


* Build initiatives to improve employee engagement and morale.
* Regularly measure employee sentiment through surveys, 1:1s and structured feedback.
* Identify cultural issues before they become attrition problems.
* Build a strong internal communication cadence.
* Design employee recognition programmes.
* Drive team\-building, town halls, offsites and cultural initiatives.
* Create an environment that is ambitious, energetic, entrepreneurial and collaborative.
* Ensure employees feel heard while maintaining high organisational standards.



 You will be expected to answer one fundamental question:
 



**"Why should a great person want to spend the next five years at 10x Global?"** 



 4\. Compensation \& Benefits
 * Build and maintain a competitive compensation philosophy.
* Conduct periodic market benchmarking.
* Develop salary bands by role and level.
* Establish clear promotion and compensation frameworks.
* Manage annual increments, bonuses and incentive programmes.
* Design performance\-linked compensation structures.
* Review benefits and employee welfare programmes.
* Ensure internal equity across teams and geographies.


 5\. Learning \& Career Development
 
 Build a culture of continuous learning.
 


* Create career paths for major functions.
* Establish competency frameworks by level.
* Identify skill gaps across teams.
* Build internal and external training programmes.
* Develop leadership programmes for managers and future leaders.
* Create structured onboarding and 30/60/90\-day programmes.
* Encourage internal mobility and cross\-functional exposure.
* Build succession plans for critical positions.


 6\. HR Operations \& Systems
 
 Professionalise the HR infrastructure of the company.
 


* Establish clear HR policies, SOPs and processes.
* Implement/optimise HRMS and employee records.
* Digitise leave, attendance, payroll coordination, performance and documentation.
* Ensure accurate employee data and HR reporting.
* Establish clear SLAs for HR queries and employee requests.
* Build a central HR dashboard for management.
* Ensure statutory and employment compliance across relevant jurisdictions.
* Work closely with finance and external advisors on payroll and employment matters.



**Objective:** 
 HR should become predictable, process\-driven and data\-led.
 


 7\. Employee Relations
 
 Act as a trusted but objective point of contact for employees and leadership.
 


* Handle employee grievances and workplace conflicts.
* Investigate sensitive employee matters objectively.
* Support managers in difficult people decisions.
* Manage disciplinary processes where required.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify recurring organisational issues.
* Ensure consistent application of company policies.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional judgement in sensitive matters.


 8\. HR Analytics \& Management Reporting
 
 Move HR from
 **administration to intelligence** 
 .
 



 Build a monthly HR dashboard covering:
 


* Headcount
* Hiring pipeline
* Time\-to\-hire
* Cost\-to\-hire
* Attrition
* Voluntary vs involuntary exits
* Employee tenure
* Performance distribution
* Compensation
* Absenteeism
* Engagement scores
* Open positions
* Hiring plan vs actual
* Revenue/headcount and productivity metrics



 Provide the CEO and leadership team with
 **actionable insights** 
 , not just reports.
 


 Strategic Responsibilities
 
 As a member of the leadership team, you will also contribute to:
 


* Organisation design
* Workforce planning
* New geography expansion
* Leadership hiring
* Succession planning
* Culture design
* M\&A / integration\-related people matters
* Building international HR infrastructure
* Employer branding
* Organisation\-wide transformation initiatives


 What We Are Looking ForMust Have
 * 8–12 years of progressive HR experience.
* Experience managing HR for a high\-growth organisation.
* Strong understanding of talent acquisition, performance management and employee relations.
* Demonstrated ability to build HR systems from the ground up.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business understanding — you should understand how the company makes money, not just how HR works.
* High ownership and execution orientation.
* Ability to operate independently in an entrepreneurial environment.


 Strongly Preferred
 * Experience in consulting, professional services, financial services, technology or a high\-growth startup.
* Experience managing multi\-location or international teams.
* Experience working directly with founders/CEOs.
* Experience implementing an HRMS.
* Experience designing performance and compensation frameworks.


 The Ideal Personality
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**High ownership** 
 — doesn't wait to be told what to do.
 



**High empathy, high standards** 
 — cares deeply about people without compromising performance.
 



**Commercially minded** 
 — understands that people decisions ultimately affect growth and profitability.
 



**Hands\-on** 
 — willing to personally solve problems rather than delegate everything.
 



**Data\-driven** 
 — uses evidence rather than anecdotes to make HR decisions.
 



**Discreet and trustworthy** 
 — comfortable handling highly sensitive information.
 



**Energetic** 
 — capable of bringing life and momentum into the organisation.
 



**Firm when required** 
 — capable of having difficult conversations with employees and senior leadership.
 


 First 90 DaysFirst 30 Days — Diagnose
 * Meet every functional leader.
* Understand organisation structure and reporting lines.
* Review current employees, open positions and hiring pipeline.
* Audit existing HR policies and processes.
* Analyse attrition and employee feedback.
* Identify immediate people risks.
* Establish baseline HR metrics.


 Days 31–60 — Build
 * Introduce HR operating calendar.
* Establish hiring process and recruitment SLAs.
* Define performance\-management framework.
* Create HR dashboard.
* Fix critical HR process gaps.
* Establish employee communication cadence.
* Begin compensation benchmarking.


 Days 61–90 — Transform
 * Launch performance framework.
* Implement career levels and role expectations.
* Launch engagement programme.
* Build annual workforce plan.
* Establish talent\-review process.
* Present a
 **12\-month People Strategy** 
 to the CEO.


 KPIs for the Role
 
 The Head of HR will ultimately be measured on:
 


1. **Quality of hiring**
2. **Time\-to\-hire**
3. **Employee retention**
4. **Employee engagement**
5. **Performance\-management effectiveness**
6. **Manager effectiveness**
7. **HR process efficiency**
8. **Employee satisfaction with HR**
9. **Leadership/talent pipeline**
10. **People productivity**


 The ultimate objective:
 
**Build a high\-performance organisation where great people join, perform, grow and stay — while making HR scalable enough to support 10x Global's next phase of growth.**

**About the Role:** 




 The
 **Head – HR \& Administration** 
 will lead the organisation's end\-to\-end people and administration function, with responsibility across HR strategy, recruitment, payroll, compliance, performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, administration, HR MIS and budgeting.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on HR leadership role** 
 suited to someone who can build and strengthen people systems in a lean and growing organisation. The role will work closely with the COO/Director of Operations, programme and functional leads, managers and employees across locations, while managing a small HR team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. HR Strategy, Policies \& Systems** 



* Review existing HR policies and practices, identify gaps and drive improvements.
* Develop, update and implement policies covering leave, conduct, grievances, travel, expenses, performance, safeguarding and other employee\-related areas.
* Develop and maintain an annual HR calendar covering recruitment, onboarding, appraisals, increments, employee engagement, learning and compliance.
* Build and maintain HR dashboards covering headcount, attrition, open positions, training, compliance and other key people metrics.
* Ensure HR policies and practices are aligned with applicable labour laws and regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen HR processes and systems to support organisational growth and consistency.



  





**2\. Recruitment \& Onboarding** 



* Own the end\-to\-end recruitment process across functions, from understanding hiring requirements and developing JDs to sourcing, interviewing, selection and offer management.
* Build talent pipelines through job portals, professional networks, referrals, institutional partnerships and sector networks.
* Track recruitment timelines and provide regular hiring updates to leadership.
* Design and improve structured onboarding processes covering organisational culture, policies, compliance, systems and role clarity.
* Ensure timely collection and maintenance of employee documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant teams for IT assets, email IDs, system access and other onboarding requirements.
* Strengthen internship and volunteering processes as potential talent pipelines.



  





**3\. Payroll, Benefits \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Coordinate monthly payroll processing for employees in partnership with the payroll vendor.
* Provide accurate payroll inputs covering new joiners, exits, leave, loss of pay, salary revisions and other changes.
* Ensure timely compliance related to PF, ESI, TDS, PT and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Manage employee queries related to salary, benefits, PF, advances and other compensation matters.
* Process salary revisions, annual increment letters and Full \& Final settlements.
* Manage employee insurance administration, including renewals and claims support.
* Support periodic compensation benchmarking and benefits reviews.



  





**4\. Performance Management** 



* Design and implement a structured performance management cycle covering goal setting, mid\-year reviews, annual appraisals and development planning.
* Support managers in setting meaningful goals and conducting effective performance conversations.
* Ensure performance reviews are completed within defined timelines.
* Identify high performers and support managers in addressing performance concerns.
* Connect performance outcomes with increments and career development decisions in a transparent and consistent manner.



  





**5\. Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Design and implement employee engagement initiatives across teams and locations.
* Develop and manage Reward \& Recognition initiatives.
* Plan and coordinate employee events, team meetings and organisation\-wide engagement activities.
* Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee concerns and grievances and ensure appropriate resolution.
* Support the development of a positive, inclusive and people\-centric workplace culture.
* Strengthen internal communication and employee experience across the organisation.



  





**6\. Learning \& Development** 



* Conduct training needs assessments across functions and levels.
* Identify learning priorities and coordinate relevant internal and external training programmes.
* Manage mandatory training programmes such as POSH, safeguarding and compliance training.
* Maintain training records and track completion and learning hours.
* Support managers in identifying development needs within their teams.
* Mentor and develop the HR team member through effective delegation, coaching and feedback.



  





**7\. Administration \& Office Operations**

description:
The Strategy Lead is a senior, high\-ownership role at the centre of Impact Beacon's growth. Designed for someone who can operate across strategy, organisational building, and innovation, this person will work in close partnership with senior leadership, taking on meaningful responsibilities and enabling the organisation to operate at its highest value.
 




  






 This is not an implementation\-only role. It requires someone who can think at the level of the organisation, identify where the business needs to go next, design the structures that will get it there, and take ownership of new initiatives from concept through execution. Critically, this person must be equally comfortable in a room with clients as they are behind a strategy document, representing Impact Beacon with credibility, depth, and presence.
 




  






 The ideal candidate brings direct experience in or with the nonprofit sector, understands how these organisations function across their different departments, and can translate that understanding into sharp advisory thinking. They are as comfortable building frameworks as they are getting things done.

***Strategy and Planning***



* Lead the development and maintenance of organisational strategy, ensuring clarity on direction, priorities, and resource allocation.
* Support senior leadership in designing and executing key strategic initiatives across Impact Beacon's advisory practice.
* Conduct research, market analysis, and landscape scans to inform strategic decisions and identify new opportunities.
* Prepare strategic briefs, position papers, and decision\-support materials that allow leadership to move with speed and confidence.

* Build and maintain systems and processes that allow the organisation to operate effectively as it scales.

* Lead the development of new offerings, market extensions, or strategic partnerships from concept through viability assessment and launch.

* Lead or support client\-facing conversations, including discovery calls, engagement reviews, and senior stakeholder meetings.

**Role Expectations** 





 This role requires a high degree of ownership, intellectual rigour, and the ability to operate without a clear playbook. The successful candidate will be as comfortable building a strategy framework as they are leading a client conversation or developing a new service offering. They will take initiative, exercise good judgment, and bring structure to ambiguity.
 




  






 Impact Beacon works closely with nonprofit leaders who are navigating real operational and strategic pressure. * 5 to 8 years of experience in strategy, consulting, organisational development, or a combination of these.

* Experience designing or contributing to organisational structures, systems, or people strategies.
* Ability to develop new ideas into well\-structured, viable initiatives.
* High degree of ownership and follow\-through, comfortable working independently on complex problems.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where priorities shift and clarity must be created, not inherited.



  





**Who Will Thrive Here** 





 You will thrive in this role if you are energised by building things, not just improving them. You think at the level of the organisation, not just the task in front of you. You are comfortable moving between high\-level strategy and ground\-level execution. You understand how nonprofits work from the inside, the pressures their leaders face, the constraints they operate within, and what it actually takes to help them move. You can hold a room with a client and hold a complex strategic workstream at the same time. Leadership can hand you a half\-formed problem and trust that something clear, considered, and actionable will come back.
 




  





**Growth Opportunity** 



* Direct exposure to senior leadership decision\-making across strategy, growth, and organisational design.
* Ownership of high\-impact initiatives at a pivotal stage of the firm's growth.
* Exposure to advisory work across a growing portfolio of nonprofit and social impact clients globally.
* Opportunity to shape Impact Beacon's future offerings, market position, and internal architecture.





 ﻿
 





**About Impact Beacon** 





 Impact Beacon is a strategic knowledge partner that mission\-driven organisations rely on to succeed. We help organisations strengthen critical but non\-core functions so they can focus on their mission. Our solutions span Donor Lifecycle and Community Management, People, Culture and Talent Systems, Governance and Financial Systems, and Operational Continuity and Internal Systems.

This role is responsible for end\-to\-end accounting, statutory and tax compliance, providing financial analysis to support business decision\-making, as well as providing local administrative and HR support.  4\. Treasury \& Cash Management
 


* Monitor cash flow, working capital, and liquidity positions to support business operations and growth.

 5\. Audit
 


* Respond to internal and external audit requests as required, providing accurate and timely information and supporting documentation.

 6\. Local HR Support \& General Operations

* Bachelors degree in accounting, finance or other related majors, MBA in Finance is a plus.

 Experience:
 


* 4\-7 years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, and tax compliance, with at least 2\-3 years in big 4, fintech, or financial services environment.



  
 



 Technical Skills:
 


* Strong understanding of Ind AS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, and ROC compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (financial modeling, pivot tables, complex formulas) and experience with ERP/finance software.
* Experience with Zoho Books, or similar accounting software is a plus.



  
 



 Soft Skills:
 


* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present complex financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* High integrity, ownership mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

* Conduct the compensation benchmarking exercise using structured external survey data (Aon, Mercer, or equivalent); translate outputs into a comprehensive compensation grid covering mass roles, campus hires, niche positions, and senior leadership.
* Design and maintain a structured job architecture \- job families, bands, and pay ranges \- inclusive of rubber\-banding rules, promotion eligibility thresholds, and freeze parameters, ensuring the framework supports both internal equity and business agility.
* Manage the end\-to\-end ESOP lifecycle — grants, vesting, exercises, and lapses — in coordination with Legal, Finance, and the Company Secretary, ensuring full compliance
* Manage the annual merit and variable pay cycle \- data governance, calibration support, HRIS interface, and payroll handoff \- with full audit\-readiness at each stage.
* Partner with stakeholders on compensation budgeting, cost modelling, and affordability analysis, ensuring all reward recommendations are commercially grounded prior to leadership approval.
* Prepare, structure, and present the annual compensation proposal to the Management \- covering senior leadership remuneration, variable pay outcomes, proposed adjustments, and benchmarking substantiation.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for the organization pertaining to compensation, remuneration philosophy, and market positioning.
* Lead the end\-to\-end benefits revamp \- benchmarking the current portfolio against market norms, identifying gaps, designing a competitive and cost\-efficient benefits package, and executing implementation.
* Govern all group benefit schemes \- mediclaim, term life, personal accident, and supplementary covers \- across the full lifecycle: enrolment, renewals, endorsements, claims oversight, and utilisation analysis.
* Own policy design, periodic review, and governance as a component of the broader perquisites framework.
* Design the R\&R framework. Establish R\&R governance standards \- equity of access, linkage to performance outcomes, and periodic calibration of recognition quality and distribution.
* Partner with the PMS Lead on performance\-to\-reward linkage design, ensuring calibration outputs translate into differentiated and commercially defensible compensation decisions.
* Own, maintain, and periodically review the Incentive Policies, Promotion Policy, and R\&R Policy as components of the total rewards governance framework.
* Build and maintain compensation and benefits analytics infrastructure \- dashboards, equity reports, and market positioning analyses \- to support evidence\-based reward decision\-making.

**Internal** 



* CHRO / HR Leadership \- remuneration philosophy, strategic alignment, Board preparation \- annual compensation proposal
* Finance \- budget governance, cost modelling, statutory compliance
* Business Heads / CXOs \- compensation mix design, perks framework, retention constructs
* HRBPs \- reward advisory for individual and cohort\-level decisions
* Talent Acquisition \- offer competitiveness, grid\-based hiring parameters
* Payroll \& HRIS \- cycle execution, data accuracy, system integration
* Legal \& Compliance \- SEBI disclosures, Companies Act obligations, labour law adherence



**External** 



* Compensation survey providers (Aon, Mercer) \- benchmarking data and methodology
* Insurance brokers and TPAs \- mediclaim, life, PA governance and renewal negotiations
* R\&R platform vendors \- evaluation, procurement, and implementation

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources.
